name: attack
description: Taking action to degrade the state of others for your benefit or for an important other.

variations.description: Many animals fight over terrory, and humans will fight over all kinds of things like land, treasure, and job titles.

variations.name: threatening life or health
variations.description: Hunting, or additionally in the case of primates, crime and war.

variations.name: attacking reputation
variations.description: Working to degrade the social status of another.

variations.name: destroy something of value
variations.description: Destroying something of value to someone else not because you want it, but to spite the other.
